Bill.BriefDescription: Designating the Walla Walla sweet onion as the official Washington state vegetable.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to designating the Walla Walla sweet onion as theofficial Washington state vegetable; and adding a new section tochapter 1.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The Walla Walla sweet onion is designated as the official vegetableof the state of Washington.
